scoring_justification: Checker recomputes relative energies and deprotonation energy from agent's raw total energies and compares to paper-reported values with tolerances; T1 is feasible because raw total energies are provided.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference relative energies and deprotonation energy from the paper's Table 3 and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 and text (Section 'Results and discussion'): ΔE(B30/48)=0.77 eV, ΔE(B53/30)=0.95 eV, ΔE(B*)=1.29 eV; E_a=20.6 eV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported numbers; the checker compares the agent's recomputed values to them.

outputs.description: Raw total energies that the checker uses to recompute relative energies and deprotonation energy against hidden gold.

output_contract.notes: All energies must be reported in eV. The checker will compute ΔE(B30/48), ΔE(B53/30), ΔE(B*) relative to A43/43, and the deprotonation energy E_a = E(B30_48_deprot) - E(B30_48). Ordering and tolerances are hidden.

steps.description: Recompute relative energies and deprotonation energy from raw total energies; compare to paper gold within tolerances and check ordering.
